thread:
jamie-release: Heads up — the prod canary for release v1.12.3 is spiking 5xxs at ~12:41 UTC, ~8% error rate. Rolling traffic is at 5% canary. Can we pause and evaluate?
incident-bot: Incident created: CANARY_ERROR_SPIKE (id: C-20260317-01). Paging darren-oncall.
deploy-bot: Deploy v1.12.3 canary started by jamie-release at 2026-03-17T12:39:02Z. Canary route: canary-5pct.
darren-oncall: I'm paged, looking now. Can anyone confirm whether this is a model or infra regression?
maya-sre: Checking infra metrics — no node OOMs, CPU fine. Latency for token generation increased on canary hosts. Correlation with model shard logs shows repeated kv-cache misses.
jamie-release: We pushed a quantization change and a kernel bump in this release. Lucas, any known risk?
lucas-eng: The kernel bump could cause slightly different memory layout; the quantization was A/B tested in staging but not in long-tail sequences. Recommending immediate rollback of canary to previous model variant.
jamie-release: Agreed. Darren, can you initiate a manual backout of the canary and hold traffic at 0%?
darren-oncall: Initiating backout now. Command I'm running: ```bash
redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --route canary-5pct --percent 0 --deployment v1.12.2
```
deploy-bot: Received rollback request for route canary-5pct. Draining traffic... removing canary instances from LB.
incident-bot: Note: customer priority flag set to P1 for top-tier customers served by this route. Notify support if we expect user-visible errors.
rina-support: Notifying support tier 1 to watch dashboards and reply to any incoming tickets.
darren-oncall: Traffic at 0% now, canaries drained. Confirming 5xx rate back to baseline on global prod: 0.4% over last 2 minutes.
maya-sre: Starting smoke verification: run health-check and sample prompt through stable model variant.
maya-sre: Smoke test results: ok for 30/30 prompts, latencies back to normal. No kv miss patterns in logs after rollback.
jamie-release: Good. Action items: 1) Keep v1.12.3 blocked from auto-promote 2) Create a rollback RCA ticket 3) Re-run long-tail tests against kernel bump + quantization in a dedicated performance harness.
lucas-eng: I'll reproduce with a seeded long sequence, and add instrumentation for kv-cache hits.
olina-pm: I'll draft a short customer blurb if needed — anything visible to customers reported?
rina-support: So far no new tickets. Watchlist on for 30m.
darren-oncall: I'll keep the rollback cookie in place and monitor metrics for 30m before clearing the hold. If anything regresses, escalate to oncall-2.
jamie-release: Thanks team. Marking incident closed in the thread once metrics stable. Adding the incident tag to the release notes. :white_check_mark:
